title: trialbox doctor could not read the hold after a restore on an installed box

findings.claim: on an installed box trialbox doctor's restore_hold check could not read screening.after_restore (the host's python3 has no database client: ModuleNotFoundError; with the box's libraries there is no database address from the host: OperationalError), and said so as a WARN that passed, while RUNBOOK §5 says doctor shows the hold
findings.severity_basis: the operator's check is blind right after a restore: an operator can be told nothing is held while the screening hold is on
findings.fix: doctor reads the hold through the box (tools/trialbox/box_hold.py: compose exec db psql with the box file's runtime, never the host's Python or a caller's variable); the image's doctor takes the host's reading; tests/unit/test_doctor_reads_the_hold.py
findings.from: the walk's report 7145893589 and the integrator's card 7145902865 on #639, 2026-11-24

findings.claim: a hold that could not be read was a WARN, so trialbox doctor passed with the box possibly held; it is now a FAIL naming the cause
findings.severity_basis: doctor passed while it could not say whether the box makes patient lists
findings.fix: held is a WARN with who, when and the reason, released a PASS, unreadable a FAIL with the cause; test_an_unreadable_hold_is_a_fail_naming_its_cause_never_a_warn

findings.claim: RUNBOOK §5 step 4 did not name the release path's second step: the change on /ops/flags is made only by the "Please confirm" page's button "Yes, do it" (the walk's first two tries stopped at that page)
findings.severity_basis: an operator may believe the hold released when the form alone changed nothing; doctor now shows it
findings.fix: runbook page 05, step 4: the console page, the reason, Change, then Please confirm and Yes, do it; no release command

findings.claim: the real-box path (the rehearsal job's doctor and live-restore steps with the installed trialbox doctor on the host) was not run in this session: no container engine here
findings.severity_basis: the reader is shown against a real psql and PostgreSQL 16 behind a stand-in engine, not against a box's db container
